answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the violet graph. Re-attestations are stored in saffron and yarrow lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 3 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1928 impostors cost 1153 times the honest price and take 17 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
